issue.title: Enhancement: Add new testcase to verify default strict priority

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the enhancement

Create an test which validate default strict priority behavior.
In default strict priority, TCs will be services in the descending order of priority (i.e TC7, TC6…. TC0).

### Current Behavior

Existing test only validate PIR/CIR in case of strict priority scheduler.

### Proposed Behavior

Validate priority across TCs.
